Every PS Plus monthly game

All 479 PS4 and PS5 monthly games Sony has given PS Plus members since the PS4 launched in November 2013, newest first. These are the North American lineups. Each month's games could only be claimed during that month, so if you were a member then and claimed them, they're still in your library to play while you subscribe. Games marked In Extra now are back in the Game Catalog, so Extra and Premium members can play them even if they missed the month.

The PS3 and PS Vita games Sony also gave away until 2019 aren't listed. A game offered twice appears under its most recent month. Spot a gap? Let us know.

Tags are saved in this browser and shared with the wall. If you have an account, they sync the next time you open the wall.
